name: Yin Release Adept: Yin Release – Veil of mystery

system.description:
You can adjust the workings of your Yin Seal, allowing for you to share your visions with your foe, but only the ones you want to share. While a creature is marked with a Yin-Seal, you can spend 1 Foresight, targeting them to conjure a Misfortune which can only be used against them once before the end of your next turn. You can only maintain 1 Misfortune at a time. You can spend Misfortune to achieve one of the following;

Foretold Despair. subtract 1d4 from an attack roll, Skill check or saving throw they make.

Foretold Failure. To nullify any one jutsu based bonus, benefit or effect that applies to them.
